Kai H (partnerships): Heads-up: channel created to coordinate cloud marketplace onboarding tasks across teams. Primary objective: finalize staging listing artifacts for AWS/GCP/Azure and lock legal + pricing.
Rita S (eng): I'll own the build pipeline for hardened AMIs and the manifest validator. ETA for first staging AMIs is 10 business days.
Devon M (product): We need one-liners for each marketplace plan limited to 90 chars to satisfy GCP overview constraints. Also want to surface feature bullets for the Azure plans.
Olivia P (legal): Please ensure each SKU row includes: export_control, data_subprocessing, indemnity_exceptions. I'll translate into the marketplace contract fields.
Ben K (finance): Add marketplace_revenue_code and internal_sku to the CSV so payouts reconcile automatically. Also request a mapping doc for price tiers to our revenue recognition categories.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: AWS private offers require a distributor contact for contract routing. Add field: distributor_contact.
Kai H (partnerships): Sharing a quick CSV sample to align on columns:
```
sku,display_name,price_model,regions,ami_id,state,summary,export_control,data_subprocessing,internal_sku,marketplace_revenue_code,distributor_contact
RI-DED-XS,Redwood Dedicated XS,monthly,us-west-2|eu-west-1,STAGE-AMI-100,staging,Low-latency dedicated inference,EAR99,redwood-dpa-v1,INT-DED-XS,RCODE-201,dist-sales@redwood.com
RI-HOST-PRO,Redwood Hosted Pro,consumption,global,,pending,Streaming API with function calls,EAR99,redwood-dpa-v1,INT-HOST-PRO,RCODE-105,
```
Rita S (eng): We'll populate distributor_contact after partnerships sync. For now we can leave blank for Hosted plans.
Devon M (product): I'll produce 90-char summaries and short feature bullets for Azure. Posting drafts later today.
Olivia P (legal): Small note: some marketplaces want a separate privacy_link per SKU. Can we standardize a privacy URL that appends ?sku= to track acceptance?
Ben K (finance): Good idea. Also include a pricing_tier_code that maps to marketplace price book IDs.
marketplace-bot: GCP publisher onboarding step 5 still pending: test deployment of offer.
Kai H (partnerships): Ok action list: Rita build AMIs + validator, Devon drafts copy, Olivia prepares legal snippets, Ben & I wire up reconciliation fields. Sync Thurs 10am PT to review. If anyone can't make it, ping here with blockers.
Devon M (product): One more Q: should we include a support_tier field per SKU to control marketplace display (basic/premium/enterprise)? Would help set expectations.
Ben K (finance): Yes include support_tier. It also affects revenue deferral rules.
Rita S (eng): Understood. I'll add support_tier to manifest validation.
marketplace-bot: AWS certification window opens in 3 business days. Ensure staging manifests are uploaded.
